subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.------PART.
description: Second diagram on page 493, paired with VT-DY × DIS-C-CT above. IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is crossed with PART (participation). IF-ST-DY sits at top-center with the subject-arrow, and the main line runs straight down from it; INFO-DY (information dynamics) branches from the main line to the upper-left, AFI (affinity insight) branches from the INFO-DY line, and ACT (activism) from the AFI line. TRS (transition) branches from the main line near its lower end out to the left; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches from the TRS line to the far-left, and TR-INFO (trans-information) from the PROG-CONT line. SOC-RT (social reality) branches from the main line to the right margin, RT-IMP (reality implications) branches from the SOC-RT line to the lower-right, and CN-INFO (controlled information) from the RT-IMP line. PART sits at the bottom-center as partner-axis terminus.
